subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Neon Noir
email_body:
Hi Nina,

It was lovely to learn that Neon Noir, the first book in your Cyber City Saga, grew out of writing during your baby's nap times, and that synthwave and cyberpunk music shaped the neon world of Cyber City. I also saw that book two is planned for fall 2026.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

With a new installment on the way, readers coming to the series will be looking for ways to step into Cyber City quickly. If a short cinematic trailer or a few promotional reels for Neon Noir is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the feature.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Neon Noir best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
